title: Long-lived computer Phase 2a: supervisor, poll route, idle timeout (docs/LONG_LIVED_COMPUTER.md)
description: Supervisor loop, poll route (heartbeat merged), dispatch of parked turns, per-turn child, per-turn credentials through the broker, idle timeout 15 min and stop-request with veto, quiet publish, already_serving start check, max lifetime 50 minutes, watchdog, new log lines, removal of the legacy host service. Scenarios: features/computer_owner_long_lived.feature. Decisions accepted 2026-10-12: D1 to D15 as recommended.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Phase 2a is implemented and merged (PRs 516 contract, 517 A0 foundation, 518 supervisor, poll route, broker) and verified live on development: one owner served two back-to-back turns (turns_served=2), polling backs off from 1s to 3s, the quiet publish ran, and owner_idle logs idle_seconds against the 900 s timeout. Not yet proven live: idle shutdown after 15 minutes with a published snapshot, crash recovery, drain; tracked in chatticus-c24177. Local image build and test_owner_container.sh not yet run: chatticus-6c66c5. CI concurrency cancellations: chatticus-36012d. Closing this task.

right_now_summary: Phase 2a is merged and verified live; idle shutdown, crash recovery, and drain still need proof.
